text:
sara: Noticed IO hysteresis during safetensors warmup on canary. Token-bucket refill causes a waterfall of queued prefetches. Need a defensive prefetch hysteresis + decrypt hint.

jon: Can you paste a tiny log excerpt? Is this hitting node IO cap or tenant-level rate limit?

sara: excerpt:```
2026-03-20T05:21:30Z warmup enqueue shard=2 size=1.4GB
2026-03-20T05:21:30Z rl: tb empty, queued=26
2026-03-20T05:21:34Z rl: refill -> dequeue 26
2026-03-20T05:21:34Z io: read_bytes/sec=950MB/s
2026-03-20T05:21:35Z evict=98 pages
```
smaller bursts seen for mmapped bins but safetensors index-first makes it worse.

mike: Quick mitigation: add hysteresis around token-bucket drain so runtime spaces dequeues across a short window and limits concurrent prefetches. Also support manifest hint `decrypt_cpu_ms_per_mb` to adapt pacing for encrypted bundles.

jon: sketch of manifest hint: `"warmup": { "mode": "hysteresis", "rate_mb_s": "25", "concurrent_prefetch": "2", "decrypt_cpu_ms_per_mb": "12" }`

sara: runtime pseudocode idea:```
allowed = rate_limiter.allow(size)
if not allowed:
  sleep(wait + jitter)
else:
  if concurrent_prefetches >= cap: sleep(penalty)
  start_prefetch()
  // record prefetch_start_ts
  sleep(hysteresis_spacing)
```

mike: Add telemetry: prefetch_concurrency, prefetch_backoff_count, decrypt_cpu_ms_per_mb (measured), warmup_mode_switches. If prefetch_backoff_count spikes, auto-escalate to more aggressive spacing.

infra-bot: Incident created: CANARY-warmup-hysteresis-2026.

jon: Agreement: prototype runtime hysteresis + manifest hint toggles. Orchestration will expose cluster default `warmup.rate` and `warmup.concurrent_cap`. Sara, can you own a small RFC update and perf job spec?

sara: On it, will drop draft in #eng-ml and link ticket. Thanks.
